Class JavaPsi

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.internal.JavaPsi
public final class JavaPsi extends Object
Shared, stateless PSI/VFS resolution utilities for the IntelliJ toolkits.

Consolidates the file/project/member resolution logic that would otherwise be duplicated across CodeModel, CodeRefiner, Refactor and other Java toolkits, and pins down the single canonical member-FQN scheme (pkg.Type.name(erasedArg,...) for methods, pkg.Type.field for fields).

Threading: the VFS lookups (findVirtualFile(String), findHostProject(VirtualFile)) are thread-safe, but every method that returns or traverses live PSI (findPsiFile(Project, VirtualFile), findClass(Project, String), primaryClass(Project, VirtualFile), findMember(Project, String), findAnnotatable(Project, String), methodFqn(PsiClass, PsiMethod)) MUST be invoked inside a read or write action; the returned PSI must not escape that action.

anahata

  • Method Details

    • requireSmart

      public static void requireSmart(com.intellij.openapi.project.Project project) throws AgiToolException
      Ensures the project's indexes are available before a PSI/search operation, blocking the calling (background tool) thread for a bounded time if indexing is in progress.

      PSI stub indexes, short-name caches, references search and refactorings all read the indexes and either throw IndexNotReadyException or return incomplete results while the IDE is in dumb mode. Tool methods call this first (never on the EDT or inside a read action) so that, rather than failing opaquely, they either proceed on fresh indexes or report a clean, retryable message.

      Parameters:
      project - the project whose indexes are needed.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if the IDE is still indexing after SMART_MODE_WAIT_MS.

    • requireSmartForOpenProjects

      public static void requireSmartForOpenProjects() throws AgiToolException
      Ensures indexes are available for every open project (used by tools that operate across the whole workspace rather than a single project).
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if any open project is still indexing after the bounded wait.
